proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + species_trait family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — no species_trait kind exists. The tracer has no branch for species_trait_root and cannot process this unit at all.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Large Form is kind: 'species_trait' per the survey manifest — no matching UnitRecord variant exists in types.ts.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed in ClassFeatureEffect (or equivalent species-trait effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait grants +10 Speed for its duration. modify_speed exists in v4 atom inventory but is absent from ClassFeatureEffect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp only). A species-trait effect union would also need this variant.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait grants Advantage on Strength checks. RollKind covers only attack_roll and saving_throw; ability checks are not representable, so modify_roll_advantage cannot be applied to the correct roll kind.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on Strength checks

proposed_widenings.name: change_size
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait transforms the creature's occupied size to Large for the duration. No existing v4 effect atom covers creature size change. alter_item_kind is scoped to items and does not apply.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

proposed_widenings.name: acquiredAtLevel / level-unlock gate for species traits
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait becomes available only at character level 5. ClassFeatureRecord has acquiredAtLevel, but no equivalent field exists for species traits, and the current surface has no general level-threshold guard on feature activation.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind and the tracer has no species_trait_root branch. All five secondary gaps would also need resolving before the unit could be encoded cleanly. Blocking gap list in priority order: (1) SpeciesTraitRecord kind + mechanics family; (2) modify_speed effect atom in the species-trait effect union; (3) ability_check in RollKind; (4) change_size effect atom; (5) character-level unlock gate field.
